page.layout: One printed page of text in one main column; marginal notes in the left margin and the right margin beside the text; running head at the top; page number at the top right.

main_text.p: a mo adeò atq; operâm eo vacet, dicit. Euripi- Euripi- des qui calluit tanta fuit, ut vulgo μισογέλως Pausan. in Attica. dicebatur, & noctu à satrapis in Macedonia a- Attica. pud Archelaum Regem lacessatus est. Aristophanes ...

[The remainder of the column is largely illegible at this scan resolution; the printed text continues in the same manner through the page, with Greek and Hebrew words, names such as Aristophanes, Plato, Sophocles, Thucydides, Alcibiades, Aristotle, Euripides, Pericles, Pausanias, Venus and Athenians, and a heading reading SACRA below the middle of the page.]
main_text.head: SACRA.
main_text.p: Apud Iudaeos origo Ecclesiae nunc pro-Iudaeos ... Alexandri tempora descendit, Prin-cipes ... Sacerdotii ... quod ... nostrae ... ad oculos ... tempus, ut huius quadringentarum, ...

page.notes: Much of the page is faded and blurred; the marginal notes are small and mostly illegible, and the transcription of the running text in the lower half is uncertain. Doubtful readings are marked as illegible where the scan does not allow reading. The bottom lines of the main column are very faint and the last line of the printed column is not reliably readable.
